run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the starting index of the maximum average subarray of length k
test_f_gold: test f_gold with an array, its length, and subarray size k to verify correct index output
review_f_gold: review f_gold sliding window logic that computes the max sum subarray of fixed length k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-in sum instead of manual accumulation for the initial window
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the start index of the subarray with maximum average using a sliding window
